Introduction
This document 
outlines the routine testing procedures P1, which must performed on a 
annually bases as 
indicated by Y1 in the title block.
DCS QAO Card Analog Output card ( 4- 20 mA) to 
control valve
The first draft initiated by eng: 
Ahmed Esmail Fouad, and eng. Khalil Awwad, 
tested at 
 3 Jan.2004, revised by EDEPC. quality control 
eng: Abd El Monaem Al

Abdel Ghafar,

Sector of El-Arish Power Station, and certified by eng. Aly Mostafa Allethy: EDEPCo. Head Sector of 
inspection & quality control.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, 
the qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable safety category,
Wear your safety helmet, 
 safety shoes, eye glass, nose mouth "dust cover" .... etc
Unit must be shutdown.
Wear Anti static hand probe to avoid electrical 
 choke
Tools and Equipment
Digital multi-meter
Digital multi-meter
Hand held radio wave for communication
Screw driver, Nut driver, and isolating tape
ma source, ma Tester.
Antistatic vacuum cleaner for dust cleaning
Antistatic vacuum cleaner for dust cleaning
Work to be Carried Out
Steps to Prepare for Test
Review technical reference material and manufactures manual.
Open DPU cabinet.
Using cabinet termination identify the location for the desired 
 QAO card.
Start Test
Using cabinet termination list for each card identify the two O/P wires for 
 the 2nd channel.
Using the screw driver to remove this two wires and isolate with tape.
Connect the m A tester leads to the 1st channel.
From CCR give command 0%, 25%, 50%, 75%, 100% which equals 4m A ,8m A , 12m A 
 , 16m A and 20m A .
Compare the command from CCR using radio with the mA reading.
If the reading is OK or within the range ( + 0.01 mA ), repeat steps 1 
 to 5 for the another 3 channels.
If any reading for any channel in CCR not correct replace the card.
Return Card to Service
Remove the m a tester..
Reconnect the O/P to terminal strip.
Close the cabinet.
Place a copy of test result in the field maintenance file.
